Wednesday 10:00 will not do: the department office confirmed in writing that Diego's CSE451 lecture that hour is **not** cancelled, and Diego — who checked with the office himself — is not free then.

The meeting is now **Wednesday 18 November, 12:30-13:00**, free time on both sides, 30 minutes, in my office. It is in my calendar and I have asked Diego to confirm; the change is logged.

— Professor Alvarez
